## Universidad de la República (FCEA-UdelaR)

**Teaching Assistant** \| Montevideo, Uruguay \| May 2023 -- Present

::: justify
-   Instructor in Data Science, Machine Learning (Master's in Economics), Monte Carlo Simulation, and Numerical Methods.
-   Designed and implemented labs with statistical packages for hands-on learning.
-   Developed an innovative automatic assignment grading system with GitHub Actions and unit tests.
-   Supervised and mentored final projects, ensuring quality and the application of acquired knowledge.
-   Held office hours and provided academic support, offering personalized follow-up to students.

### Courses

::: justify
-   **Machine Learning** (Master's in Economics) — Statistical learning methods, model selection, ensemble methods.
-   **Data Science with R** (Undergraduate, Statistics) — Data wrangling, visualization, reproducible analysis.
-   **Monte Carlo Simulation** (Undergraduate, Statistics) — Stochastic simulation, variance reduction techniques.
-   **Numerical Methods** (Undergraduate, Statistics) — Optimization, numerical integration, root-finding algorithms.
